report_metadata.phase: Phase 6 — R-01 leg part_map splits + R-02/R-05 QA upgrades
report_metadata.scope: work/rb_buster/override.json recipe iteration (2-way -> 3-way -> full per-member), tools/rigid_plate_qa.py scissor pair-counts + BVH seam proximity, tools/diagnose_trs.py quat-preferred PASS4
report_metadata.spec_version: 1.4.0 (unchanged — no new knobs; keyframe_max_stops/keyframe_tol_m already existed)

recipe_final.part_map: each of leg_l/leg_r/leg_f split into 8 single-member parts (leg_x0..leg_x7 = P0..P7); proximal multi-member groups removed entirely
notes: leg_f0/leg_f1/leg_f2 classify as spin (kf=0) — front-leg proximal members rotate in place; leg_l0/l1, leg_r0/l1 are 6-kf hinges
distal terminal links (P5/P6/P7 equivalents) hit the 50-stop RDP cap — they are the fast-whip members
WARN_NONRIGID_CHAIN no longer fires on legs (no multi-member leg groups remain); WARN_AUTO_SPIN_PART on leg_f0-2 is expected

measurements.buster_pass3c: vacuous for legs — zero multi-member leg groups remain; deployed per-member residual eliminated by construction

key_findings.claim: R-01 resolution required FULL per-member splits, not 2-way/3-way. Proximal 3-member groups still carried ~0.28m deployed per-member residual (PASS3C); even 2-member distal groups showed 0.45-0.62m interior centroid dev. Only single-member groups make PASS3c vacuous and PASS4 worst <=0.0214m.
key_findings.evidence: PASS4 worst progression 0.064 (2-way) -> 0.027 proximal-only (3-way) -> 0.0467 (per-member distal, 30 stops) -> 0.0214 (per-member all, 50 stops). PASS3c leg residuals 0.22-0.29m on proximal 3-member groups disappeared only after full split.

key_findings.claim: Distal whip links are keyframe-starvation limited, not split limited. At keyframe_max_stops=5/12/30 the same distal parts (P5-P7) produced worst probes 0.257/0.173/0.047m; at 50 stops all probes <=0.0214m. They still hit the cap — convergence is marginal.
key_findings.evidence: leg_l7/leg_r7/leg_f7 all emitted exactly 50 keyframes; EXCEEDS count 86->17->0 across the three rebuilds.

key_findings.claim: R-05 BVH seam filter is a 60x false-positive reduction with no loss of true positives: 121 -> 2 seams, both genuine sub-cm proximities (R_UpperArm vs Spine3 islands 503/504 vs 584, min surf dist 0.004/0.007m).
key_findings.evidence: tools/rigid_plate_qa.py _islands_close: >=2 of <=32 sampled verts within AABB-pad threshold via BVHTree.find_nearest; conservative AABB fallback when island lacks polys.

key_findings.claim: R-02 pair counts rank the 41 scissor clips meaningfully: parent/child joint overlaps (calf->thigh, thigh->pelvis) carry pairs=1-16; foot-vs-foot cross-limb clips (islands 20/22 vs 761/762/764) carry pairs=1-5 and remain the suspicious class.
key_findings.evidence: FK_SCISSOR_CLIP lines now suffix pairs=N from BVHTree.overlap tri-tri count.

key_findings.claim: PASS4 now prefers emitted chained 'quat' over euler 'rot' reconstruction. Measured zero delta on buster (euler roundtrip was already exact), but it removes a whole error class for >180deg swing hinges where euler branch-hopping could corrupt slerp.
key_findings.evidence: tools/diagnose_trs.py predict_pose: Quaternion(k['quat']) when all keyframes carry it.

remaining_issues.issue: 41 scissor clips still unclassified. pairs= ranking now available; foot-vs-foot cross-limb clips (SKEL_L_Foot vs SKEL_R_Foot islands) are the suspicious subset — likely stance-width/rest-pose issue, not joint articulation.
remaining_issues.suggested_fix: Classify by bone-hop distance + laterality: adjacent-bone parent/child = design overlap (accept); cross-limb = review rest-pose foot placement. Optionally gate on pairs>=3.

remaining_issues.issue: 2 remaining seams: islands 503/504 (SKEL_R_UpperArm) vs 584 (SKEL_Spine3), 2 bone-hops, min surf dist 0.004-0.007m — genuine near-contact across a real kinematic gap; likely a shoulder-pauldron floating 4-7mm off the spine plate.
remaining_issues.suggested_fix: Manual review of islands 503/504/584 in the mech source; probably weld or accept as armor gap.

remaining_issues.issue: 36 parts on buster (24 leg links alone) + up to 50 keyframes on whip links = larger manifest and more attach entities per tick. No consumer exists yet for sf_buster_drone (manifest-only prop), so cost is latent.
remaining_issues.suggested_fix: When a Lua/attach consumer lands, budget-check parts x keyframes; consider keyframe_max_stops per-part or topology-aware caps. Consider raising global default only if other assets show the same starvation.

remaining_issues.issue: Render comparison vs REFERENCE_buster.jpg is evidence-only this phase: numeric gates (PASS3b=0, PASS4<=0.0214, PASS3c vacuous) are the verified signal; buster_PHASE6_*_iso.png regenerated for consultant review but no automated image diff exists.
remaining_issues.suggested_fix: Consultant/pixel review of the three PNGs vs testing/REFERENCE_buster.jpg; if leg silhouette gaps appear at deployed pose, the remaining error is in spin-classified leg_f0-2 (they rotate in place rather than translate — check whether front legs should hinge instead).

remaining_issues.issue: leg_f0/leg_f1/leg_f2 auto-classified as spin (WARN_AUTO_SPIN_PART) — front-leg root/mid members rotate >300deg with <5cm travel. If the source intent was deployment translation, spin classification may be wrong; visually verify against reference.
remaining_issues.suggested_fix: Compare deployed render front-leg pose vs REFERENCE_buster.jpg; override spin->hinge in part_map dict form if needed.
